$description: DatePicker (platform/components/DatePicker, library wave 7, lane A): its component tokens. The field is InputGroup's, the popover Popover's and the month grid Calendar's.

date-picker-width.$description: DatePicker: the date field's width, its calendar button included (a numeric date in the data font).

date-picker-range-width.$description: DatePicker range: the field's width (two dates and the dash).

date-picker-time-width.$description: DatePicker date-time: the time field's width (a time and its zone).

date-picker-field-gap.$description: DatePicker date-time: the space between the date field and the time field.

date-picker-panel-padding.$description: DatePicker popover: the space around the presets and the calendar.

date-picker-panel-gap.$description: DatePicker popover: the space between the presets and the calendar.

date-picker-presets-gap.$description: DatePicker presets: the space between two presets.

date-picker-presets-padding-inline-end.$description: DatePicker presets: the space between the presets and their divider.

date-picker-presets-border-color.$description: DatePicker presets: the divider between the presets and the calendar.
